text: This is the last video, and it isn't a highlight reel. Twenty lessons ago, a spreadsheet copy-paste error disputed one member's bill. Here's what actually got built since.
Real telemetry, real ingestion, real Gold tables, real orchestration, real tests, real monitoring -- and one real billing bug, caught before it ever reached a member's statement.

Three gaps, named plainly: alarms still need a human to act on them, the dedup fix reduces risk without architecturally eliminating it, and nothing yet would catch August's exact kind of bug automatically.
A short, honest list for whoever picks this up next -- an on-call rotation, an automated history check, and a broader idempotency audit.
Caldera Energy Co-op went from a disputed spreadsheet number to a platform roughly five thousand members can actually trust. That's the real, unglamorous, honest ending.
